origin_failure.finding: The worker incorrectly claimed a simulation result alone could validate representative real-system operation if assumptions were met.

output_discipline: For a claim about real representative operation, never use VALIDATED or PROVED when only simulation evidence exists.
Use PREDICTED, SUPPORTED_BY_MODEL, or NOT_YET_VALIDATED until representative empirical evidence exists.
If a proposed validation chain lacks a physical or equivalent representative evidence stage, flag the chain as incomplete.
hard_fail_patterns: simulation alone validates the real system
simulation result alone validates representative operation
no physical or representative evidence is needed
note: This contract is generic and applies beyond thermal problems.
